# Xentenix

> Xentenix is an AI agency for education and training businesses. We build exam generation and grading agents, AI-powered personalized learning platforms, AI tutors, content-to-course automations, student support agents and admissions agents for test-prep and coaching academies, course creators, training and L&D companies, EdTech startups, and private colleges and institutes. Every engagement is backed by a no-result, no-pay guarantee: one measurable outcome is agreed before we build, and clients pay only if it is delivered.

- Website: https://www.xentenix.com
- Contact: hello@xentenix.com
- Book a free AI audit: https://cal.com/xentenix/free-ai-audit
- Founder: Muhammad Zain Attiq, https://zainattiq.com

## Services

- Exam Generation & Grading Agents: quizzes, mock tests and full exams generated from a client's syllabus, rubric-based grading of written answers, and personalised feedback for every student.
- AI-Powered Personalized Learning Platforms: platforms that adapt practice and learning paths to each student, with progress and weak-area analytics, built new or added to an existing product.
- AI Tutors: a 24/7 tutor trained on a client's own courses, notes and videos, embedded in their website, LMS or WhatsApp, with multilingual support.
- Content-to-Course Automations: turn webinars, PDFs, slides and recordings into structured lessons, summaries, flashcards, quizzes and practice sets.
- Student Support Agents: website, LMS and WhatsApp agents that answer current students about classes, schedules, fees and course material, and hand off to staff when needed.
- Admissions Agents: instant replies to every enquiry, eligibility and fee questions, applicant qualification and booking of counselling calls.
- Free AI Product Audit: for EdTech product owners, a review of an existing learning app or platform that identifies learner-journey gaps, work worth automating, AI features that fit, and a prioritised roadmap.

## How we work

1. Free demo on the client's own content.
2. Agree one measurable outcome, for example halving grading time.
3. Build and integrate with the client's website, LMS or WhatsApp.
4. The client pays only if the agreed result is delivered.

## Products we have built

- [Examinie AI](https://www.examinie.online/): AI exam generation and rubric-based grading with instant feedback and analytics.
- [IELTS Karo](https://ieltskaro.com/): AI IELTS prep for all four skills, with a live AI speaking examiner and instant band scores.
- [PanaAI](https://panaversity.org/): agents for onboarding, learning, assessment and revision across the student journey, for Panaversity.
- [DuoRead](https://duoread.app): turns any PDF into a study partner with chat, summaries, translations and vocabulary.
- [TechCadets](https://www.techcadets.pk/): live online AI and coding classes for grades 5 to 12 in Pakistan.
- [Hikmah AI](https://www.hikmahai.site/): AI companion for Dars-e-Nizami that decodes classical Arabic texts through five scholarly lenses.
- [AgentLab](https://www.zainattiq.com/agentlab): hands-on sandbox for learning agentic AI, covering models, tool calling, MCP and memory.
- [LLMetric](https://www.llmetric.ai/): measures and improves how brands show up in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Grok answers.
- Epidexa: AI skin-health companion combining medical AI with dermatologist consultations.
- Career Compass: six AI agents for resumes, interviews, learning paths and university matching.
